nodes.title: Notes on using uploaded video
widgets_values:
Disable the IT2V group and activate this one. Connect the "IMAGE" output of the "Load Video" node to the "Set_BATCH1" node and the "audio" output of the "Load VIdeo" node to the "Set_AUDIO1" node. 

WARNING: Uploaded videos must be 10s long to work.

nodes.title: Notes and Warnings
widgets_values:
v8:
- Finally fixed the visual blip in the merge while preserving audio merge. Now trimming the last 2 seconds of the first video with the first 1 second of the second video and combining directly without any overlap.

v7:
- Fixed issues with audio not merging correctly.
- Changed shift to 6/3.
- Added a fifth video generation.
- Connected RIFE to get nodes.

v6: Switched to HardGravy's 6-step turbo LoRA. Merge nodes added back in. 

v5: 
- Added the optional ability to use an incoming video stream directly into the second video generation. 
- Removed image merges because they take too much ram. You will need to concatenate them manually.
- Removed the subject prompt becuase it would interfer with downstream generations. 
Note: I tested the new 4-step v1.2 lightning lora and it's crap. The 8-step 768p comfyui bf16 is the best. 

v4: Some crap I don't remember that didn't work very well.

v3: Switched lightx2v minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors using shift 8/3.

v2: First video is 10s, other videos is 13s to make up for the 3 seconds lost for each overlap.

Olm Drag Crop resets after each upload. It's recommended to check and readjust the crop area after each new upload. The aspect ratio of the cropped area should match the aspect ratio of the video. By default the aspect ratio of the crop area is locked. Common aspect ratios are:
1.000: 768x768
0.750: 768x1024
1.333: 1024x768

The I2V seems to work best with 10 second videos. 

The lightning LoRA works best at 8 steps stength 0.75.

The video extend takes 3 seconds of video context from the preceeding video and uses it to continue the motion of the next. This means that after each merge, the video will be 3 seconds shorter than the combined length. E.g. If video 1 is 10 seconds and video 2 is ten seconds, the combined will be 17 seconds, etc.

For the video merges at the bottom, the audio merge is additive so that the last 3 seconds of the first video will overlap with the any dialogue or noise in the first 3 seconds of the next video.
